fullPassage: Politicians tend to speak of crime as if it were a simple, obvious concept. When Donald Trump opened his presidential election campaign in 2015 with the claim that Mexican immigrants were 'bringing crime' across the border, American voters may have agreed or disagreed with him. But they would not, generally speaking, have been confused about what Trump meant by crime. His explanation that Mexicans 'are bringing drugs' may well be an extremely racist stereotype, but as an example of crime, drug smuggling is relatively uncontroversial. However, different political perspectives can easily reveal that the apparent obviousness of crime is illusory. In the years following the mass protests of 2012, Vladimir Putin and the Russian government broadened the definition of espionage to include reporting and other journalistic activities. As Masha Gessen writes, this means that 'contrary to popular perception and common sense, in Russia, "espionage" does not need to mean working for a foreign intelligence service or even a foreign government', but includes 'gathering information for any foreign organization the Russian government sees as threatening the security of the country'.

questions.stem:
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

Politicians tend to speak of crime as if it were a simple, obvious concept. When Donald Trump opened his presidential election campaign in 2015 with the claim that Mexican immigrants were 'bringing crime' across the border, American voters may have agreed or disagreed with him.

(A) However, different political perspectives can easily reveal that the apparent obviousness of crime is illusory. In the years following the mass protests of 2012, Vladimir Putin and the Russian government broadened the definition of espionage to include reporting and other journalistic activities.

(B) But they would not, generally speaking, have been confused about what Trump meant by crime. His explanation that Mexicans 'are bringing drugs' may well be an extremely racist stereotype, but as an example of crime, drug smuggling is relatively uncontroversial.

(C) As Masha Gessen writes, this means that 'contrary to popular perception and common sense, in Russia, "espionage" does not need to mean working for a foreign intelligence service or even a foreign government', but includes 'gathering information for any foreign organization the Russian government sees as threatening the security of the country'.

det.korean: 유권자들이 범죄의 의미에 혼동하지 않았고 마약 밀수는 범죄로서 논란이 적다(B) → 그러나 다른 정치적 관점은 범죄의 명백함이 허상임을 드러낸다. 러시아가 간첩 정의를 확대했다(A) → Masha Gessen이 러시아의 간첩 개념이 상식과 다르다고 설명한다(C).
det.analysis:
도입문은 트럼프의 2015년 선거운동에서 멕시코 이민자와 범죄 주장을 제시한다.

✅ ③ (B)-(A)-(C): (B) 'But they would not... have been confused'가 도입문의 'agreed or disagreed'를 직접 이어받아 유권자 반응 설명 + 마약 밀수가 범죄의 비논쟁적 예시 → (A) 'However'가 전환하며 범죄의 명백함이 허상임을 주장 + 러시아 간첩 정의 확대 → (C) 'this means that'의 this가 (A)의 정의 확대를 받아 Gessen의 구체적 설명으로 마무리

❌ ① (A)-(B)-(C): 'However'가 도입문 직후에 오면 마약 밀수 예시 없이 전환하여 논리 비약

❌ ② (A)-(C)-(B): (B)의 'But they would not'이 마지막에 오면 이미 끝난 트럼프 주제로 회귀

❌ ④ (B)-(C)-(A): (C)의 'this means'가 (A) 없이 지시 대상 부재
det.tip: 도입(트럼프 주장) → (B)유권자 이해+마약 밀수 예시 → (A)However 전환+러시아 사례 → (C)Gessen 인용으로 구체화

questions.stem:
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

Politicians tend to speak of crime as if it were a simple, obvious concept.

(A) His explanation that Mexicans 'are bringing drugs' may well be an extremely racist stereotype, but as an example of crime, drug smuggling is relatively uncontroversial. However, different political perspectives can easily reveal that the apparent obviousness of crime is illusory.

(B) In the years following the mass protests of 2012, Vladimir Putin and the Russian government broadened the definition of espionage to include reporting and other journalistic activities. As Masha Gessen writes, this means that 'contrary to popular perception and common sense, in Russia, "espionage" does not need to mean working for a foreign intelligence service or even a foreign government', but includes 'gathering information for any foreign organization the Russian government sees as threatening the security of the country'.

(C) When Donald Trump opened his presidential election campaign in 2015 with the claim that Mexican immigrants were 'bringing crime' across the border, American voters may have agreed or disagreed with him. But they would not, generally speaking, have been confused about what Trump meant by crime.

det.korean: 트럼프의 2015년 선거운동에서 범죄 주장과 유권자 반응(C) → 마약 밀수는 비논쟁적이지만 범죄의 명백함은 허상(A) → 러시아의 간첩 정의 확대와 Gessen 인용(B).
det.analysis:
도입문은 정치인들이 범죄를 단순하고 명백한 개념으로 말한다는 일반 진술이다.

✅ ② (C)-(A)-(B): (C) 'When Donald Trump...'가 도입문의 일반 진술에 대한 구체적 예시로 트럼프 사례 제시 + 유권자가 혼동하지 않았다는 점 → (A) 'His'가 (C)의 Trump를 지칭 + 마약 밀수 예시 후 'However'로 전환하여 범죄의 명백함이 허상이라 주장 → (B) 'In the years following'이 (A)의 허상 주장을 러시아 사례로 뒷받침 + Gessen 인용으로 결론

❌ ① (A)-(B)-(C): 'His'의 지시 대상(Trump)이 없어 비문

❌ ③ (C)-(B)-(A): 러시아 사례(B)가 'However' 전환(A) 없이 트럼프 바로 뒤에 오면 논리 단절

❌ ④ (B)-(A)-(C): 러시아 사례가 먼저 나오면 도입문의 '명백한 개념'과 연결 불가
det.tip: 도입(정치인의 범죄 인식) → (C)트럼프 사례+유권자 이해 → (A)마약 밀수+However 전환 → (B)러시아 간첩 확대+결론

questions.stem: 다음 글에서 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은? "In other words, what counts as a crime can depend heavily on who holds political power and how they choose to define it."

det.korean: 삽입 문장: 다시 말해, 무엇이 범죄에 해당하는지는 누가 정치 권력을 쥐고 있고 어떻게 정의하기로 선택하느냐에 크게 좌우될 수 있다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① S1 뒤: 도입 직후. 아직 구체적 사례 없이 'In other words'로 요약하기엔 이름

❌ ② S2 뒤: 유권자의 동의/반대 직후. 아직 정치 권력에 의한 범죄 정의 변경 사례 미등장

✅ ③ S4 뒤: 마약 밀수가 비논쟁적이라는 점 설명 완료 + 'However'로 범죄의 명백함이 허상임을 전환하기 직전. 삽입문이 이 전환의 핵심 논지(범죄 정의 = 정치 권력 의존)를 명시하여 러시아 사례로의 연결을 강화 ← 정답

❌ ④ S6 뒤: 이미 러시아 정의 확대를 설명한 후. Gessen 인용 직전에 삽입하면 흐름 중복
det.tip: ③: 마약 밀수 = 비논쟁적(S4) → 범죄 정의는 정치 권력에 좌우(삽입문) → However, 명백함은 허상(S5)

det.korean: 삽입 문장: 이 재정의는 평범한 언론 활동을 하룻밤 사이에 범죄 행위로 바꿔 놓았다.
det.analysis:

❌ ② S3 뒤: 마약 밀수 예시 직후. 러시아 간첩 정의 확대 아직 미언급이므로 'This redefinition'의 지시 대상 없음

❌ ③ S5 뒤: 러시아 정부가 간첩 정의를 확대했다는 내용 직후이지만, 뒤에 Gessen 인용이 'this means that'으로 이어지는데, 삽입문이 끼면 'this'의 지시 대상이 모호해짐

가정법 과거: as if + S + were. 실제와 반대되는 가정 표현.

det.analysis:

questions.passage: Politicians tend to speak of crime as if it were a simple, obvious concept. When Donald Trump opened his presidential election campaign in 2015 with the claim that Mexican immigrants were 'bringing crime' across the border, American voters may have agreed or disagreed with him. But they would not, generally speaking, ________________________ by crime. His explanation that Mexicans 'are bringing drugs' may well be an extremely racist stereotype, but as an example of crime, drug smuggling is relatively uncontroversial. However, different political perspectives can easily reveal that the apparent obviousness of crime is illusory. In the years following the mass protests of 2012, Vladimir Putin and the Russian government broadened the definition of espionage to include reporting and other journalistic activities. As Masha Gessen writes, this means that 'contrary to popular perception and common sense, in Russia, "espionage" does not need to mean working for a foreign intelligence service or even a foreign government', but includes 'gathering information for any foreign organization the Russian government sees as threatening the security of the country'.

det.analysis:
원문: 'have been confused about what Trump meant'
have been confused(현재완료 수동 = 혼란스러워했을 것이다) + about(~에 대해) + what Trump meant(트럼프가 의미한 것) = 7단어.
조동사 would not 뒤 have + been + p.p.(confused) = 가정법 과거완료. about what Trump meant = 간접의문문.
det.tip: have been confused about what S meant = S가 의미한 것에 대해 혼란스러워했을 것이다. 가정법 과거완료 수동태.

det.korean: the Russian government sees as threatening the security(러시아 정부가 안보를 위협하는 것으로 간주하는).
det.analysis:
원문: 'the Russian government sees as threatening the security'
the Russian government(러시아 정부) = 관계절 주어 + sees(간주하다) + as threatening(위협하는 것으로) + the security(안보) = 8단어.

det.tip: see A as B = A를 B로 간주하다. the Russian government sees [it] as threatening the security = 안보 위협으로 간주하다.
